summary: The explicit construction, cell-area calculations, positive-spill invocation, vanishing upper bound, and computation and affine invariance of the displayed width are correct. However, the candidate's final universal conclusion about every valid correction is not implied by the construction and is false as stated.
critical_errors: The assertion that any valid correction of (1) must retain width or eccentricity does not follow. The family proves only that no positive lower bound can depend solely on (p_emptyset,q_1,q_2), and it exhibits one affine-invariant width that diverges along the family. A valid correction could instead depend on other geometric or cell parameters, so the construction does not establish necessity of width or eccentricity.
gaps: The terms "valid correction," "retain width or eccentricity," and "that parameter" are not defined, and no quantified class of corrected inequalities is specified from which the claimed necessity could be deduced.
repair_hints: Limit the conclusion to the proved statements: area-only positive bounds are impossible, the displayed width diverges along this family, and any proposed bound that depends on this width cannot remain uniformly positive on this family as the width tends to infinity.
